The Memory Observatory
An evidence investigation room you operate with your hands. Built on MNEME.
Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026 · Productivity · New Experience
The moment trust breaks
A decision relied on a memory. Later, its source was quarantined.
Agents, pipelines and people now write into the same memory system. When a result comes under question, reading what the system remembers is not enough. You need the path back to the source, and proof that the path is intact.
Can this memory still be trusted?
Who picks it up
For the moment someone asks: which evidence produced this, and can we prove it?
01
Researchers and scientists
A result will guide the next experiment. Before it does, they need to see what it rests on.
02
Forensic and incident analysts
A compromised feed touched the record. They need to know exactly what it reached, and to keep the proof.
03
Safety and compliance engineers
An automated decision must be explainable after the fact, to someone who was not in the room.
04
Teams operating AI agents
Several agents share one memory. When one goes wrong, the team needs to contain it with authority, not with hope.
Investigation first. Evidence, custody, dependencies, bounded counterfactuals.
What ENGRAM is
A room where memory becomes evidence you can investigate.
Every capsule on the bench is a real memory held by MNEME, the engine that decides and proves. ENGRAM makes those decisions inspectable and operable through the body.
Five physically distinct places: the factual field, its provenance, the counterfactual chamber, the intervention station and the verification vault. Nothing in the room invents evidence, and nothing changes without authorization.
Step 1 of 5
Which memory deserves our attention?
Colour is the custody state MNEME declared, and nothing else. Every capsule is the same size and shape, because size never means authority.
One of them is marked: its source was quarantined after a decision had already used it. Point at it and pinch to open the record.
CLEAN
TAINT_FLAGGED
QUARANTINED
SUPERSEDED
Step 2 of 5
Where did this memory come from?
Its custody chain rises above it as hash-linked blocks, in the server's own order, each labelled with the event, the actor and its hash.
Read it bottom-up: who stored it, who used it, who flagged it. The full record, with every hash, is one press away on the inspector.
Step 3 of 5
What depended on this information?
Trace draws MNEME's own impact report as arcs over the field. Four kinds of edge, four looks, and every edge says its kind in words.
A solid bar is a recorded decision. Dashes are derived. Thin dashes are derived but unattested. A hairline is merely possible, and it can never pass for a cause.
DIRECT
DERIVED
UNATTESTED
POSSIBLE
Step 4 of 5
What would change without it?
The counterfactual chamber is a separate sealed column, never a recolour of the field. The same query runs against the recorded world and against a hypothetical one.
Both answers, both receipts and the delta hash stand side by side. The hypothetical is prepared, compared and sealed, and it never merges into the field.
Step 5 of 5
What would an intervention do, and who may do it?
Place an actor totem in the amber cradle and the field previews exactly which memories a quarantine would flag. Nothing has changed yet.
Commit is a separate, signed-in action. MNEME's authority gate decides who may contain what, and refuses an actor without the grant. The room shows the verdict; it never overrides it.
The answer travels with its proof
The investigation is preserved.
Export the field as a sealed bundle. An independent verifier, a separate program, checks it, and the vault shows exactly what it printed.
What you found leaves the room in a form a third party can check without trusting the presentation: the memory, the chain, the typed edges, the bounded comparison.
Your hands. Your browser. Your team.
One live field, reached three ways.
HANDS FIRST
Point, pinch, pick up.
Point at a capsule and pinch to open it. Hold the pinch to lift the record off the bench and turn it in your hand while its chain and arcs follow. The whole investigation, sign-in included, runs on hand tracking alone. No controller is ever paired.
ALSO ON THE WEB
The same room, flat.
Open the public link in any browser on a laptop and the observatory runs flat: drag to look around, click to act. Every surface, every step, the same live field, with nothing to install.
WORK AS A TEAM
Shared field, personal authority.
Everyone who opens ENGRAM sees the same live memory field. Reading, tracing, comparing and verifying are open to all. Sign in to act with your own authority, and every action lands in the custody chain under your name.
Seated, within arm's reach. A complete investigation in under ten minutes.
From plausible answers to verifiable provenance.
